messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 — smart-routing anomalies detected for region-us-east. Multiple requests hit fallback loop. Policy engine reported runtime error during rules evaluation. Auto-escalating to on-call.

olivia: ack — I'm oncall. seeing elevated 5xxs from the routing proxy, correlated with policy-engine logs. customers affected: a subset of hosted API tenants in us-east. impact: increased latency + 500s, some requests stuck in retry loops. will triage.

sam: copying logs here, error shows invalid expression in policy: `expr: request.metadata['region'].toLowerCase() == 'us-east'`

sam: stack trace snippet:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
at policy_engine/eval.go:412
at router/smart_route.go:128
```

maria: that expression used to be guarded. looks like request.metadata can be nil for internal health probes -> policy engine didn't validate expressions and panicked, triggering circuit fallback which routes to another region -> that region's policy also panics -> cascade/loop.

olivia: immediate mitigation: disable smart-routing policy evaluation for affected customers in us-east. moving them to static routing until we patch. @eng-oncall can you run the toggle? steps: 1) set policy.eval.enabled=false for tenant group = hosted-eu? actually hosted-us-east. 2) monitor 5xxs.

eng-oncall: running toggle now: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/admin/policies/disable -d '{"group":"hosted-us-east","flag":"eval"}'` -> 202 accepted.

eng-oncall: confirm: 5xxs dropping on edge in last 30s from 12/s -> 2/s. latency back to normal for most tenants. keeping watch.

jason: good call. we should also add a defensive validation in the policy compiler: reject expressions referencing possibly-missing path without `?` safe op, or default to empty string. I'll open a hotfix PR to add nil-safety and a runtime guard to catch panics and return evaluation error (not panic).

sam: PR #2456 opened: add nil checks + recover in eval loop. also add a preflight validation step during policy upload to run expressions against sample request shapes.

tanvi: heads-up — we need to notify customers impacted. drafting incident note for support to post: short message that some requests were returning 500 due to routing policy error, we disabled smart routing for their traffic and will re-enable after patch. no data loss.

olivia: paging timeline: 17:02 incident-bot alert -> 17:03 oncall ack -> 17:05 mitigation toggle -> 17:09 observed improvement -> 17:20 PR opened for fix -> 17:45 hotfix deployed to canary policy-engine -> 17:58 re-enable for a small subset -> 18:10 full re-enable after monitoring looks good. total customer-facing window ~1h 8m. assign followups.

maria: root cause summary to post in incident retrospective: missing nil-safety in policy expression handling + lack of runtime isolation (panic propagated to router causing fallback churn). also uncovered missing static validation for uploaded policies.

olivia: action items:
- sam: merge and backport hotfix to stable (priority: high)
- jason: add server-side validation + unit tests for common request shapes
- eng-oncall: add an emergency toggle endpoint with faster rollback and audit log
- tanvi: publish customer-facing post and coordinate with support
- maria: postmortem draft due tomorrow EOD

sam: hotfix merged to main and backported to stable/2026.2. deploying now to policy-engine fleet.

eng-oncall: deployment tagged `policy-hotfix/178900` -> canary deploy in us-east. healthchecks green.

olivia: re-enable smart-routing for a small canary tenant group.

eng-oncall: re-enable command executed -> monitoring shows no panics, 5xx rates stable.

tanvi: customer note sent to affected tenants via support: "We experienced a routing outage caused by an internal policy evaluation error. We disabled smart routing for your traffic while we deployed a fix. The issue is resolved and smart routing is re-enabled. No customer data was affected."

jason: post-incident follow-ups: add a fuzzing harness for policy expressions and add nil-safe operators to the expression language, consider runtime sandboxing so eval panics cannot crash the host process.

olivia: closing loop: incident severity P2 -> mitigated in ~1h. assigning owners for follow-ups. will convert this thread into a formal incident report doc.

incident-bot: Incident closed: mitigated. Assigned owners: sam, jason, maria, tanvi. Reaction :thumbsup:
